calculation.description: Reverses each asset's five-day cumulative residual shock, normalized by its 30-day downside residual volatility. The signal is active only when current cross-asset absolute residual dispersion is at least its trailing 60-day median, an interpretable regime gate intended to isolate broad dislocation and rebound conditions. All inputs are causal through the signal date.

parameters.dispersion_definition: cross-sectional median absolute residual log return

validation.regime_notes: Aggregate gates pass, with strong 2020-2024 and 2025-2027 results, weaker 2028-2029, and slightly negative 2030 YTD IC. Small 15-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
